feedbacks.subject: Clarification on eGFR cutoff for metformin in diabetic kidney disease
feedbacks.message: Requesting inclusion of updated KDIGO guideline eGFR cutoffs in renal dose adjustments.

timeline.note: Public response sent to subscriber email

replies.message: Internal Note: KDIGO guidelines verified by cardiology desk.
Thank you Dr. Rajesh. Renal adjustment tables have been updated in 2026 addendum.

feedbacks.message: In section 4.2 of the paediatric formulation, the maximum single dose mentions 15mg/kg every 4-6 hours, but daily ceiling guidance for premature neonates is missing. Kindly consider adding explicit neonate guidelines as per CDSCO circular 2025.

replies.message: Thank you Dr. Suresh. We have cross-referenced the CDSCO 2025 neonate circular and referred this to the Paediatric Scientific Sub-Committee.
Internal Note: Sub-committee approved addendum inclusion in upcoming 2026 batch release.

timeline.note: Submitted via digital formulary web portal
